video_title: Lakers & Warriors Ready To Contend? Biggest Questions for The Pacific Division Teams

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers are the current Pacific Division champions
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say it's the Los Angeles Lakers.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Can you tell me who the current Pacific Division champion is?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Howdy partners. You keep on trying to get me with this. I'm going to say it's the Los Angeles Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers won 53 games despite Luka Doncic's injuries
quotes.excerpt: Despite Luka's mid-season injury and then another late injury, they were able to overcome.
quotes.quote: Despite Luka's mid-season injury and then another late injury, they were able to overcome and claim the Pacific Division. 53 wins.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's 53 wins is a career high
quotes.excerpt: I believe I heard that was the most regular season wins for a Luka Doncic team ever.
quotes.quote: I believe I heard that was the most regular season wins for a Luka Doncic team ever, which is kind of crazy considering he's made the finals.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick is squeezing out regular season wins
quotes.excerpt: Credit to JJ Redick, he has seemed to like squeeze out regular season wins.
quotes.quote: It's also, I would say, credit to JJ Redick, he has seemed to like squeeze out regular season wins.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick has a playoff series win without Luka
quotes.excerpt: He's got a playoff win without Luka in uniform, a playoff series win.
quotes.quote: He's got a playoff win without Luka in uniform, a playoff series win.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick will coach in the NBA for a long time
quotes.excerpt: I think JJ Redick is going to coach in the league for a long time.
quotes.quote: I think JJ Redick is going to coach in the league for a long time, if he wants to.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers are the favorites to repeat as Pacific Division champions
quotes.excerpt: I would take the under 53, I would take the defending champion Lakers to probably be the champs.
quotes.quote: I would take the under 53, I would take the defending champion Lakers to probably be the champs again.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' over/under was in the mid-40s
quotes.excerpt: Their over/under was in the mid-40s.
quotes.quote: Their over/under was in the mid-40s.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Western teams played Utah four times last season
quotes.excerpt: Last year, all these Western teams got to play Utah four times.
quotes.quote: Last year, all these Western teams got to play Utah four times. And all those East teams that were tanking. They were not alone.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Memphis was tanking hard last season
quotes.excerpt: Memphis was tanking hard. There were some, you know, they weren't alone.
quotes.quote: Memphis was tanking hard. There were some, you know, they weren't alone. There were some teams.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler fits with Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Walker Kessler, we know fits with Luka. It was premium choice.
quotes.quote: Walker Kessler, we know fits with Luka. It was premium choice. Obviously, they paid a premium to get him to two first, two swaps, 130 million.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandro Mamukelashvili is a bigger player who can shoot
quotes.excerpt: Mamukelashvili, he's a bigger player who can shoot it. That's helpful.
quotes.quote: Mamukelashvili, he's a bigger player who can shoot it. That's helpful.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes is a nice 3-and-D piece
quotes.excerpt: Quentin Grimes, I think is a nice 3-and-D piece. I think he's going to be higher.
quotes.quote: Quentin Grimes, I think is a nice 3-and-D piece. I think he's going to be higher on their pecking order than he probably should be. Played with Luka, right? So there's a little bit of history.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Sexton is a fine bench scorer
quotes.excerpt: Collin Sexton, he's a fine bench scorer at his price tag.
quotes.quote: Collin Sexton, he's a fine bench scorer at his price tag, but at the same time, did this team need to use that price tag for another go-get-it scorer?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes is overrated defensively
quotes.excerpt: He's got a reputation for being a good defender, the Dallas coaches did not share that.
quotes.quote: Quentin Grimes is certainly a three. The D, he's got a reputation for being a good defender, the Dallas coaches did not share that opinion. They felt like he was pretty overrated defensively.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need another legitimate playmaker
quotes.excerpt: The things you need to surround Luka with are another legitimate playmaker. They've got Austin Reaves.
quotes.quote: The things you need to surround Luka with are another legitimate playmaker. They've got Austin Reaves. They've got great chemistry. Check.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler needs to be a better screener
quotes.excerpt: Kessler needs to be a much better screener than he had been in Utah.
quotes.quote: Kessler needs to be a much better screener than he had been in Utah. He needs to focus on that aspect of the job. That's going to be awfully important.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler is a great shot blocker, not anchor
quotes.excerpt: He's a great shot blocker, can you be a great defensive anchor? There's a difference.
quotes.quote: He's a great shot blocker, can you be a great defensive anchor? There's a difference. He needs to be a great defensive anchor. Length, athleticism, and shooting. You can argue they got the shooting part. This is not a team that has length and athleticism on the wings.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Matisse Thybulle is theoretically a good on-ball defender
quotes.excerpt: Matisse Thybulle, theoretically, Ziaire Williams, they're hoping for these minimum signings to help.
quotes.quote: Matisse Thybulle, theoretically, Ziaire Williams, they're hoping for these minimum signings to help. They're hoping for these minimum signings to help.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Matisse Thybulle creates problems on offense
quotes.excerpt: The problems that he solves on the defensive end is he creating more problems on the offensive end.
quotes.quote: The problems that he solves on the defensive end is he creating more problems on the offensive end because let's be honest, you're playing four on five offensively and teams don't guard him.
